overall_assessment: All 20 packet courses were reviewed, including both suspects. Course-specific learning-outcome lists and most assessment/coursework boundaries are preserved, but five courses lose substantive prerequisites, seven placement courses misfile teaching arrangements as course content, and five courses retain PDF footer noise. The long/leak assessment flags identify a real programme-appendix boundary error; the empty flag on VIB-101 is a false alarm because Praksisstudier names a real coursework requirement, while an unflagged control emits a genuine no-activity placeholder.

findings.evidence: Krav til forkunnskaper: BSY-100, BSY-101, BSY-102, BSY-201, BSY-202, BSYP-200
findings.description: Five courses explicitly list required prior courses in their metadata, yet none emits a prerequisites section. This affects both colon-separated 2025 metadata and aligned 2022 tables, including a wrapped prerequisite list in the final control; these are substantive entry requirements, not admission boilerplate.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The LDH section_text_header in R/institution_config.R includes Krav til forkunnskaper. R/blocks.R::.text_blocks() removes the metadata header before sectionization, losing the prerequisite values with it.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract LDH Krav til forkunnskaper values, including aligned table cells and continuation lines, into a prerequisites block before removing the metadata header. Continue suppressing blank values and Ingen.

findings.evidence:
Praksisstudier med godkjent arbeidskrav vurderes til bestått/ikke bestått.
Studiets overordnede læringsutbytter
findings.description: The assessment row is 10,537 characters although the actual assessment design is one sentence. It continues into Studiets overordnede læringsutbytter and a national programme-level competency appendix. Both long and leak->learning_outcomes are real alarms; the packet truncation marker itself is not an extraction defect. The 2022 offering of the same course has the correct short assessment row.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/blocks.R::.text_blocks() recognizes only whole known heading strings. Studiets overordnede læringsutbytter is absent from the LDH heading overrides, so the programme appendix remains in the open assessment section.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an LDH text-reader boundary for Studiets overordnede læringsutbytter mapped to .drop, ending assessment before the programme-wide appendix while retaining the course-specific Læringsutbytte section.

findings.evidence:
Emnet omfatter praksisforberedende studier (prekliniske og/eller postkliniske), hvorav
normalt 8 uker (240 timer) er tilstedeværelse i klinisk kontekst.
findings.description: Seven bachelor placement offerings put explicit teaching arrangements, including preparatory studies and eight weeks of clinical attendance, exclusively in course_content and emit no teaching_methods row. The codebook assigns how students work and clinical placement arrangements to teaching_methods regardless of the source heading Innhold. Absence of a practice overlay is not itself a defect because these paragraphs have no dedicated practice heading.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: LDH text sections follow headings, and Innhold maps the entire mixed paragraph to course_content. There is no LDH semantic relocation for the placement-arrangement sentences.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an LDH-specific sentence relocation in R/extract_sections.R for the placement-arrangement lead beginning Emnet omfatter praksisforberedende studier through the clinical-attendance duration, handling prekliniske/prekiniske and numeric/spelled-out eight. Move those sentences to teaching_methods and leave the subject-matter description in course_content.

findings.evidence: Master i klinisk intensivsykepleie. Sist oppdatert
findings.description: Five courses retain repeated PDF programme footers and, in several cases, isolated page numbers inside extracted content, learning outcomes or teaching methods. These interrupt sentences and bullet lists. All knowledge, skills and general-competence groups remain present; the problem is recurring administrative layout noise rather than truncated outcomes.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The LDH text fallback carries internal PDF page headers/footers into ordinary text blocks, and section cleanup does not remove the programme-specific Sist oppdatert footer lines.
findings.suggested_fix: Before LDH PDF sectionization, strip whole footer lines matching Master i ... Sist oppdatert or Videreutdanning i ... Sist oppdatert, and strip adjacent isolated numeric page-number lines using their footer context. Preserve surrounding prose and list items.

findings.evidence: I emnet inngår ingen obligatorisk aktivitet.
findings.description: The random control emits a coursework_requirements row whose entire text explicitly says that no compulsory activity exists. It should be suppressed as an absence placeholder. This differs from the flagged VIB-101 row Praksisstudier, which names a genuine requirement and should remain.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R::.placeholder_phrases covers several Ingen arbeidskrav forms but does not cover the sentence order I emnet inngår ingen obligatorisk aktivitet.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the whole-row placeholder matcher with the anchored LDH phrase I emnet inngår ingen obligatorisk aktivitet, allowing a terminal period, and suppress the row only when no substantive text remains.
